[[Travel Scroll to Jungle Island]] |level = {{Skill|Foraging|1}} |prev_location = [[Forest]] |next_location = *[[Galatea]] *[[Moonglade Marsh]] |sublocations = *[[Birch Park]] *[[Spruce Woods]] *[[Viking Longhouse]] *[[Dark Thicket]] *[[Trials of Fire]] *[[Howling Cave]] *[[Savanna Woodland]] *[[Melody's Plateau]] *[[Soul Cave]] *[[Jungle Island]] *[[Spirit Cave]] |mobs = *Pack Spirit *Howling Spirit *Soul of the Alpha |resources = *Birch Log *Spruce Log *Dark Oak Log *Acacia Log *Jungle Log }} '''The Park''' is the first {{Skill|Foraging}} island, consisting of several large floating islands connected by launch pads. == Locations == '''The Park''' is broken up into five areas, each devoted to a type of forest. See the sections below table for a more detailed breakdown. {{:Locations/The Park}} === Birch Park === {{Main|Birch Park}} [[File:Birch Park (0.24.1).png|thumb|Birch Park]] The {{zone|Birch Park}} is the first section of '''The Park''' and requires {{Skill|Foraging|1}}. It contains two [[NPCs]]: {{NPCSprite|Charlie}}, who sends new players in search to collect {{Item|Birch Log}}s and get to all the different sections, and {{NPCSprite|Vanessa}}, who can be paid {{C|5,000}}, to make it rain for a minute. === Spruce Woods === [[File:Spruce Woods (0.24.1).png|thumb|Spruce Woods]] The {{zone|Spruce Woods}} is the second section of '''The Park''', and requires completion of the '''Into the Woods''' quest to access. It contains three [[NPCs]]: {{NPCSprite|Kelly}}, who wants {{Item|Spruce Log}}s, the {{NPCSprite|Melancholic Viking}}, who the player can buy items from, and {{NPCSprite|Gustave}}, who gives the Woods Racing quest. ==== Woods Racing ==== {{Main|Woods Race}} The Woods Race is started by talking to {{NPCSprite|Gustave}}. The player must travel to the {{zone|Jungle Island}} and back in continually lesser amounts of time. Each tier completed grants a different reward. ==== Melancholic Viking Quest ==== {{Main|Melancholic Viking}} The {{NPCSprite|Melancholic Viking}} is located on the {{Zone|Viking Longhouse}} in the {{zone|Spruce Woods}}. The player can access their shop by using {{Item|Magical Water Bucket|amount=1}}, {{Item|Raw Cod|amount=1}}, and {{Item|Fish Hat|amount=1}}. === Dark Thicket === [[File:Dark Thicket (0.24.1).png|thumb|Dark Thicket]] The {{zone|Dark Thicket}} is the third section of '''The Park''' and requires completion of the '''A Helping Hand''' quest to access. There are four [[NPCs]] found in the {{zone|Dark Thicket}}: two {{NPCSprite|Campfire Initiate}}s, one {{NPCSprite|Campfire Adept}}, and {{NPCSprite|Ryan}}. A weak wall leads into the {{zone|Howling Cave}}. ==== Trial of Fire ==== {{Main|Trial of Fire}} The Trial of Fire can be completed to earn various [[Campfire Badge]]s. === Savanna Woodland === [[File:Savanna Woodland (0.24.1).png|thumb|Savanna Woodland]] The {{zone|Savanna Woodland}} is the fourth section of '''The Park''' and requires completion of the '''Trial of Fire''' quest to enter. There are three [[NPCs]] located in this section: {{NPCSprite|Worker Xavier}}, {{NPCSprite|Melody}}, and {{NPCSprite|Master Tactician Funk}}. There is a fourth NPC, {{NPCSprite|Romero}}, hiding in a cave, who only appears at the beginning of the [[Romero and Juliette]] quest. ==== Melody ==== {{Main|Melody}} {{NPCSprite|Melody}} is found on {{zone|Melody's Plateau}} in the {{zone|Savanna Woodland}}. They ask for {{Item|Acacia Log|amount=512}} to help fix the [[Harp]]. Fixing the [[Harp]] allows the player to complete songs to earn rewards. ==== Master Tactician Funk ==== {{Main|Master Tactician Funk}} {{NPCSprite|Master Tactician Funk}} is located in a tent near the edge of the {{zone|Savanna Woodland}}. They sell the {{Item|Tactician's Sword}} and {{Item|Wood Singularity}}. ==== Gold Mine ==== A small gold mine can be mined for {{Item|Gold Ore}}. During a quest from {{NPCSprite|Romero}}, mining the {{Item|Gold Ore}} has a chance to drop a {{Item|Yellow Rock}}. There is also a weak wall that leads to the {{zone|Soul Cave}}. === Jungle Island === [[File:Jungle Island (0.24.1).png|thumb|Jungle Island]] The {{zone|Jungle Island}} is the fifth section of '''The Park''' and requires completion of '''The Rebuild''' [[Quest]] to enter. There are two NPCs here: {{NPCSprite|Juliette}}, who longs for {{NPCSprite|Romero}}, and {{NPCSprite|Molbert}}, who requests {{Item|Jungle Log}}s, {{Item|Carrot}}s, and {{Item|String}} to make traps. Upon completing the {{NPCSprite|Romero}} Questline, he moves to the {{zone|Jungle Island}} with {{NPCSprite|Juliette}}. All of the main NPCs grant an armor piece: * {{NPCSprite|Charlie}} rewards {{Item|Charlie's Trousers}} for {{Item|Birch Log|amount=64}}s. * {{NPCSprite|Kelly}} rewards {{Item|Kelly's T-Shirt}} for {{Item|Spruce Log|amount=128}}. * {{NPCSprite|Melody}} rewards {{Item|Melody's Shoes}} for {{Item|Acacia Log|amount=512}}. * {{NPCSprite|Molbert}} rewards the {{Item|Mole Hat}} for {{Item|Jungle Log|amount=512}}. === Romero and Juliette Quest === {{Main|Romero and Juliette}} The [[Romero and Juliette]] Quest from {{NPCSprite|Romero}} and {{NPCSprite|Juliette}} requires various [[Romero and Juliette Quest Items|items]] to complete. Completing the quest rewards a {{Item|Legendary Ring of Love}}. == Mobs == {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Pack Spirit}} {{Mob Table Row|Howling Spirit}} {{Mob Table Row|Soul of the Alpha}} }} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} == Trivia == * The SkyBlock community has spent over {{C|182B|short=yes}} on rain as of August 28th, 2026. * Before version 0.23, the higher sections needed higher foraging levels to access: however, they could be reached using parkour, an {{Item|Aspect of the End}}, or a {{Item|Grappling Hook}}. * There is a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ivlmxLC3aBU video on YouTube] featuring the building process of '''The Park'''. == Gallery == Floating_Islands_(0.1).png|[[Floating Islands]] on 0.1 The Park (0.7.4).png|'''The Park''' on 0.7.4 == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Jun 5|Revamped '''The Park'''.}} |beta= {{History|2019/June 11|Added [[Floating Islands]].}} {{History|2019/August 2|First mention of The Park development.}} {{History|2019/November 11|Replaced Floating Islands with The Park.}} {{History|2021/April 30|Fixed a bug where the portal to Jungle Island would say Dark Thicket, and vice versa}} {{History|2021/November 8|Added {{Zone|Melody's Plateau}}.}} {{history|0.19.3|Added more of all tree types to '''The Park'''.}} {{History|0.23|Revamped '''The Park'''.}} {{History|0.25|Added [[Fishing Hotspots]] to the '''The Park'''.}} {{History|2026/Oct 5|Biome sky colors and particles are now correctly displayed in islands like the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Locations}} [[Category:Park]] [[Category:0.7.4]] [[Category:Foraging]]
